title: Sports World in Focus: Zaheer joins Jaffna, India arrive & FIFA shake-up
byline: From cricket moves to football’s biggest decisions, the sports world continues to make headlines. Zaheer Khan’s new role with Jaffna Kings (LPL), India’s latest arrival, and FIFA’s major developments take centre stage in today’s roundup.

title: Sports World in Focus: Zaheer's Jaffna deal, FIFA shake-up & India arrive
byline: From cricket moves to football’s biggest decisions, the sports world continues to make headlines. Zaheer Khan’s new role with Jaffna Kings (LPL), India’s latest arrival, and FIFA’s major developments take centre stage in today’s roundup.

title: Luxury bus destroyed in suspected arson attack at Kaduwela Bus Stand
byline: A luxury bus was destroyed in a suspected arson attack at the Kaduwela main bus stand early this morning, police said.

title: Woman jailed for 14 years for mariticide
byline: A woman has been sentenced to 14 years’ rigorous imprisonment after being found guilty of culpable homicide not amounting to murder over the killing of her husband in Rideemaliyedda in 2012.

title: Joint Opposition raises alarm over proposed Anti-Corruption (Amendment) Bill
byline: The Joint Opposition raised alarms over the proposed Anti-Corruption (Amendment) Bill where it stated bail provisions threaten the Fundamental Rights and will worsen the deadly prison overcrowding.

title: Referendum needed to extend judges’ retirement age, SC determined earlier
byline: The Supreme Court had determined earlier that any Constitutional amendment to the retirement age or the period of office impacting on incumbent judges, whether directly or indirectly, will impinge on the independence of the judiciary and violate Article 3 ,which requires a Referendum.

title: CID probes Ethiopia link in Canada job scam
byline: The Criminal Investigation Department’s (CID) Human Trafficking, Smuggling and Maritime Crime Investigation Division is conducting further investigations to uncover links between a suspect arrested in Kilinochchi and the organised criminal gang operating in Ethiopia that abducted three Sri Lankans after luring them with promises of jobs in Canada.

title: Clash between Minister and Deputy Minister reaches boiling point over SriLankan Airlines
byline: A major administrative crisis has erupted within the Government, as the clash between Ports and Civil Aviation Minister Anura Karunathilake and Deputy Minister Janitha Kodithuwakku reaches boiling point over the controversial push to appoint an interim Chief Executive Officer at loss-making SriLankan Airlines, according several sources within Sri Lankan Airlines.

title: Projectile sinks Indian-flagged ship off Yemen coast
byline: An Indian-flagged vessel capsized and sunk after it was hit by a projectile off the coast of Yemen, officials say.

title: Two grenades thrown at Ratmalana home
byline: A hand grenade attack was carried out on a house located on Sri Gnanendra Mawatha in Ratmalana, police said.

title: Elephant corridors to be restored under new Human-Elephant Conflict strategy
byline: The Government is planning to restore blocked elephant migration routes and establish elephant enrichment zones as part of a new national strategy aimed at addressing Sri Lanka’s long-standing Human-Elephant Conflict (HEC).

title: Protect animals during floods: AWC
byline: The Animal Welfare Coalition (AWC) has urged the public to take immediate measures to protect pets and domestic animals amid heavy rainfall and flash flood risks reported in several parts of the country.

title: Train delays on Main Line
byline: Train services on the Main Line between Gampaha and Daraluwa are experiencing delays following the discovery of a body near the Gampaha Railway Station.

title: CEA relaunches ’e-Kunu’ programme to boost electronic waste collection
byline: The Central Environmental Authority (CEA) has relaunched the ’e-Kunu’ electronic waste collection programme in a new format to strengthen the safe collection and disposal of electronic waste across Sri Lanka.

title: Colombo playground turned garage, 15-year project under spotlight
byline: Colombo Mayor Vraie Cally Balthazaar has pledged to reclaim a children’s playground that was allegedly unlawfully occupied and converted into a garage, while also promising action on several other longstanding public infrastructure issues identified during an inspection tour of the D4 Administrative District.

title: Sri Lanka to add 132 km to expressway network by 2030
byline: Sri Lanka’s national expressway network will expand by an additional 132 kilometers by the end of 2030 following the completion of four major infrastructure projects, according to Transport Minister Bimal Rathnayake.

title: US and Iran having ’very good discussions’, Trump says
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said his administration had ’’very good discussions’’ with Iran during all-day negotiations ​on Tuesday, fuelling expectations of an imminent end to the five-month conflict.

title: NBRO extends landslide warnings for four districts
byline: The National Building Research Organisation (NBRO) has extended Level 2 (Amber) landslide warnings for several areas in the Kandy, Kegalle, Nuwara Eliya and Ratnapura districts due to the prevailing adverse weather conditions.

title: Akila Viraj Kariyawasam appears before Bribery Commission
byline: Former Minister Akila Viraj Kariyawasam arrived at the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) this morning to provide a statement as part of an ongoing investigation.

title: Parliament unanimously approves salary increment of Auditor General
byline: Parliament approved the salary increment of the Auditor General today.

title: Former diplomat Kananathan congratulates President Ibrahim Traoré of Burkina Faso
byline: Former Diplomat Kana Kananathan has conveyed his warm congratulations to His Excellency Captain Ibrahim Traoré, President of Burkina Faso, and the people of Burkina Faso on the occasion of their Independence Day.

title: Two medical institutions fined Rs. 400,000 for overcharging patients
byline: The Jaffna Magistrate’s Court has imposed fines totalling Rs. 400,000 on two medical institutions for violating the Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA) Act, including possessing expired medicines and overcharging patients for laboratory tests.

title: Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv kills 14 and injures 22, officials say
byline: Russia has attacked Ukraine with ballistic missiles and drones, killing 14 people and leaving at least 22 injured in one of the deadliest strikes across Kyiv this year.

title: Sri Lanka Air Force promotes Rumesh Tharanga
byline: The Sri Lanka Air Force has promoted Corporal Rumesh Tharanga to the rank of Sergeant in recognition of his historic gold medal-winning performance in the Men’s Javelin Throw at the 2026 Commonwealth Games.

title: Indian Foreign Secretary arrives in Colombo for one-day visit
byline: Indian Foreign Secretary Shri Vikram Misri arrived in Colombo today for a one-day official visit to Sri Lanka.

title: Nearly 40 drugs fail quality tests in 2026
byline: A total of 39 drugs have failed quality tests so far in 2026, according to the Medical Supplies Division of the Health Ministry.

title: A SpaceX rocket is about to crash into the moon tonight — Can you watch it?
byline: A SpaceX rocket stage is expected to slam into the moon early Wednesday morning in a rare event that astronomers have been tracking for months.

title: DMC prepares emergency response plan ahead of scholarship and A/L exams
byline: The Disaster Management Centre (DMC) has activated emergency preparedness measures to minimise disruptions to the upcoming Grade 5 Scholarship Examination and G.C.E. Advanced Level Examination due to possible adverse weather conditions.

title: Over 400 drugstore raids conducted to ensure consumer safety
byline: The Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA) has conducted 471 raids and investigations at drugstores across the island this year as part of measures to ensure consumer safety and strengthen regulations in the pharmaceutical sector.

title: Minor flood warning issued for Mahaweli River Basin
byline: A minor flood warning has been issued for low-lying areas along the Mahaweli River Basin due to the possibility of further rainfall in the upper catchment areas and the recent opening of spillway gates of the Kotmale Reservoir.

title: Why was Akila Kariyawasam arrested?
byline: Former Minister Akila Viraj Kariyawasam was arrested today by officers of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) over allegations that he misused state-funded employees for personal purposes while serving as the Senior Adviser to the President on Administrative Affairs.

title: Can Sri Lankan Police arrest you for not carrying an NIC?
byline: A widespread belief among the public is that failing to carry a National Identity Card (NIC) in public is an offense that automatically leads to arrest. However, according to Attorney-at-Law Inspector of Police P. Amitha Abeysekara Silva from the Police Legal Division, simply not possessing an ID card is not an independent criminal offense under Sri Lankan law.

title: More than 34,000 have left forces during last five years: Deputy Minister
byline: More than 34,000 have left the tri forces during the last five years, Deputy Minister Aruna Jayasekera told Parliament today.

title: Akila Viraj Kariyawasam arrested
byline: Former Minister Akila Viraj Kariyawasam was arrested a short while ago by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC).

title: Sri Lankan Rupee strengthens slightly against US Dollar
byline: The Sri Lankan Rupee has appreciated slightly against the US Dollar today (August 5) compared to Tuesday, according to the Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL).

title: Ravi K seeks details on El Niño’s economic impact
byline: Opposition MP Ravi Karunanayake has questioned whether the government has assessed the likely economic impact of the forecast strong El Niño event expected to affect Sri Lanka during 2026/2027, including its impact on inflation, export crops, government revenue, disaster relief expenditure and the country’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP).

title: US and Iran having ’very good discussions’, Trump says
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said his administration had ’’very good discussions’’ with Iran during all-day negotiations ​on Tuesday, fuelling expectations of an imminent end to the five-month conflict.

title: Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv kills 14 and injures 22, officials say
byline: Russia has attacked Ukraine with ballistic missiles and drones, killing 14 people and leaving at least 22 injured in one of the deadliest strikes across Kyiv this year.

title: Mexican influencer shot dead during livestream
byline: A Mexican influencer, César Gastélum, has been shot dead while livestreaming on TikTok.

title: Pakistan restricts international media reporting
byline: Pakistani authorities have imposed new restrictions on international media reporting in the country in a move that has drawn sharp criticism from journalist organisations.

title: Animal Welfare Act does not ban elephants in processions: AWC
byline: Claims that the proposed Animal Welfare Act would prohibit elephants from participating in cultural processions or completely ban the chaining of elephants are false, the Animal Welfare Coalition (AWC) said.

title: Greater vigilance by CB would have prevented US$2.5 million theft : Deputy Minister
byline: The US$2.5 million theft could have been avoided if the Central Bank (CB) had been more vigilant, a Deputy Minister told Parliament today.

title: Court seeks IRD clarification before ruling in national cricketers’ tax dispute
byline: The Court of Appeal today sought clarification from the Inland Revenue Department (IRD) on whether the recently enacted amendments to the Inland Revenue Act would affect the tax dispute involving Sri Lanka’s national male and female cricket captains, before delivering its judgment.

title: Mo Salah wears new shirt and mobbed by fans as Liverpool icon jets in to seal transfer
byline: Liverpool legend Mohamed Salah has seemingly all but confirmed his new club as he was snapped sporting Trabzonspor’s red and blue home kit.

title: Two CIDA directors apologise for indecent conduct during COPE proceedings
byline: Two members of the Board of Directors of the Construction Industry Development Authority (CIDA) has apologised to the Committee on Ethics and Privileges for their indecent conduct during the proceedings of the Committee on Public Enterprises (COPE).

title: Drone carrying explosives found at German airport, police say
byline: A drone carrying an explosive device has been found at a German airport, police say.

title: Textile industry’s future depends on innovation and technology: Minister Handunnetti
byline: The future growth and competitiveness of Sri Lanka’s textile and apparel industry will depend on innovation, efficiency and the adoption of new technologies, Industry and Entrepreneurship Development Minister Sunil Handunnetti said.

title: Harsha preassurised not to include word ’fraud’ in COPF report: MP
byline: Ruling party members of the Committee on Public Finance (COPF) preassurised Commitee Chairman Harsha de Silva not to include the word ’fraud’ in the report he submitted to Parliament on the USD 2.5 million theft, Opposition MP Chithral Fernando alleged today.

title: Newly appointed Army Commander pays courtesy call on Deputy Defence Minister
byline: The newly appointed Commander of the Sri Lanka Army, Lieutenant General Nilantha Premaratne, paid a courtesy call on the Deputy Minister of Defence, Major General Aruna Jayasekara (Retd), at the Deputy Minister’s Office in Colombo today (05 August).

title: New Central Province Governor sworn in
byline: Retired Consultant Community Physician Dr. Harsha Suranga Fernando, who has been appointed as the new Governor of the Central Province, was sworn in before President Anura Kumara Dissanayake today (05) at the Presidential Secretariat.

title: CSE rebounds as heavy crossings lift turnover to LKR 8.48 Bn
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange staged a strong recovery on Wednesday, 5 August 2026, as improved buying interest across several large-cap and mid-cap counters lifted both benchmark indices.

title: Beauty contestant fined Rs. 50,000 for dancing with python
byline: A young woman who drew widespread attention on social media after performing a dance with a python during a New Year beauty pageant has been fined Rs. 50,000 by the Colombo Chief Magistrate’s Court.

title: Sri Lanka, India exchange agreements for USD 350 mn Credit Line
byline: Sri Lanka and India exchanged agreements today on INR-denominated Lines of Credit for USD 350 mn, which form part of the USD 450 mn reconstruction package extended by India in the wake of Cyclone Ditwah.

title: Govt. to continue investing in education despite economic challenges
byline: The Government will continue to prioritise investment in education despite Sri Lanka’s economic challenges, Additional Secretary to the Prime Minister A.B.M. Ashraf said, stressing that the country’s future depends on developing its human capital.

title: Akila Viraj remanded
byline: Former Minister Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, who was arrested today, was remanded till August 18 by the Colombo Chief magistrate’s Court today.

title: 24 illegal online gambling websites blocked
byline: Access to 24 illegal online gambling and betting websites operating without valid licences in Sri Lanka has been blocked with immediate effect, according to the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development.

title: BASL President says he is target of baseless personal attacks
byline: In a Facebook post, Bar Association of Sri Lanka (BASL) President Rajeev Amarasuriya said he has faced several personal attacks over the past few weeks, describing them as “false and malicious” and part of a series of baseless personal attacks aimed at undermining him.

title: Rains to intensify from tomorrow
byline: The Meteorology Department said the prevailing rainy and windy conditions over the South-Western parts of the island are expected to intensify from tomorrow due to the active South-West monsoon and continue for the next few days.

title: UNP says Animal Protection Bill undermines Perahera, backs animal welfare reforms
byline: The United National Party (UNP) today claimed that the proposed Animal Protection Bill undermines the Perahera tradition, while stressing that it does not oppose measures aimed at improving animal welfare and protection.

title: India, Sri Lanka advance FTA talks during Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri’s visit
byline: India and Sri Lanka agreed to advance negotiations on updating the India-Sri Lanka Free Trade Agreement (FTA) and welcomed the successful conclusion of negotiations on a bilateral Social Security Agreement, which is expected to be signed soon, during Indian Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri’s official visit to Sri Lanka on Wednesday.
